name: RobotEra STAR1
summary: A full-size bipedal humanoid from RobotEra that the maker no longer lists; its current full-size biped is the L7.

germany.statusNote: RobotEra no longer lists STAR1 among its products or in its purchase form; the only German-language listing (Roboter Deutschland, US-run) shows no price and "not in stock".

notes: No maker spec sheet is online any more; specs are left empty rather than taken from comparison sites.
For a buyable RobotEra full-size humanoid see the L7 (sold by RBTX in Germany).

sources.title: RobotEra website: product list (L7, Q5, M7, XHAND) and purchase inquiry form
RobotEra Star1 humanoider Roboter at Roboter Deutschland

openQuestions: Has RobotEra formally discontinued STAR1? Status here is inferred from it no longer appearing on the maker site.
No official STAR1 image or spec sheet could be found on the maker site; the reseller image was not used because its origin is unconfirmed.
